decision.formal_statement: AdmObs_x := Map_obs(DevAdm_x, candidate_orientation, B_x, D_rel, R)
decision.summary: DevAdm_x remains orientation-specific; AdmObs_x is its typed observation-orientation projection; delta_a remains the whole-continuation admissibility filter.

DevAdm_x.role: Evaluate deviation admissibility for a candidate observation orientation under boundary, domain, and residue.

AdmObs_x.role: Expose the DevAdm_x result as the observation-orientation predicate consumed by Excl_obs_x.

delta_a.role: Filter complete candidate continuations through P_adm
delta_a.kernel: P_adm = Gamma_E AND Gamma_R AND Gamma_T AND Gamma_O
delta_a.relationship: AdmObs_x may instantiate or support Gamma_O only.

mapping.ADMISSIBLE: AdmObs_x(o; B_x, D_rel, R) = TRUE, preserving witness w as orientation-admissibility provenance.
mapping.INADMISSIBLE: AdmObs_x(o; B_x, D_rel, R) = FALSE, preserving witness w as orientation-exclusion provenance.
mapping.UNDEFINED: AdmObs_x(o; B_x, D_rel, R) = UNDEFINED; Excl_obs_x returns UNDEFINED_INVOCATION rather than a valid exclusion result.

exclusion_bridge.admissible_family: Omega_x_adm := {o in Omega_obs | AdmObs_x(o; B_x, D_rel, R) = TRUE}
exclusion_bridge.excluded_family: Omega_x_exc := {o in Omega_obs | AdmObs_x(o; B_x, D_rel, R) = FALSE}
exclusion_bridge.undefined_guard: An UNDEFINED orientation prevents total-family classification unless explicit partial-family semantics are declared.

delta_a_bridge.orientation_clause: Gamma_O(q, c, R, -(i)) := AdmObs_x(ObsOrient(q); B_x(c), D_rel(c), R)
delta_a_bridge.full_filter: delta_a(Q; c, R, -(i)) := {q in Q | Gamma_E(q) AND Gamma_R(q) AND Gamma_T(q) AND Gamma_O(q)}
delta_a_bridge.restriction: AdmObs_x cannot approve a continuation independently of Gamma_E, Gamma_R, and Gamma_T.

authorized_chain: B_x -> DevAdm_x -> AdmObs_x -> Excl_obs_x(Omega_obs) -> Omega_x_adm -> RefOrient -> [Asym]_x -> <S>_x
circularity_guards: DevAdm_x does not require completed o_x.
DevAdm_x and AdmObs_x do not require <S>_x.
Mapping occurs before RefOrient and ProjectBounded.
Empty Omega_x_adm is not symmetry annihilation.
placement_action: Replace generic Adm_x in the provisional Excl_obs_x specification with AdmObs_x and attach the explicit DevAdm_x mapping.
next_action: Prepare and place a narrow Excl_obs_x predicate-mapping patch implementing AdmObs_x and its Gamma_O bridge without rebinding delta_a.
